body:
The private packed-scratch candidate is retired after its sole original benefit trial: **REJECT, 17/22 gates**. No canonical source or generated product was adopted, and no unchanged retry is planned.

The candidate retained the public five-word values while storing valid in the sign bit of the nonnegative shared error word. Only TERMS=5 non-owner scratch changed. Source and ordinary emitted-code proofs passed; all seven program tables and both optional owner shader products stayed exact. Its matched current-source baseline/candidate ELFs and actual linked shader selectors were checked before execution. The emitted helpers also add branches, masks, shifts and read-modify-write work, so reduced storage was never treated as a speed result.

The original timestamp prerequisite passed, including zero failures/errors/skips/disabled cases, 32 complete-buffer readback digests, 51 ordered markers, 54 actual executed-module joins and the mapped same-child sealed LVP/LLVM20 provider. Then the unchanged A1/B1/B2/A2 protocol ran once, with three repeats per family/slot and original cacheOFF/default JIT/300s/4GiB aggregate/2GiB reserve. All four owners exited0, retired their observed births and held identical 932-row input sets. Readbacks matched across all slots.

Original conjunctive results:

- Whole calls: **2/4** pass; forward legacy/modern +6.1454%/+9.1733%, reverse -3.3563%/+1.7432%, each requiring at least +5%.
- Inclusive stages: **14/16** pass; reverse Transport -7.0038% and reverse Endpoint(rows12) -7.8879% fail the -5% floor.
- Create plus all11 original numerical API windows: **1/2** pass; forward -1.2687% fails the 0% floor, reverse +3.7179% passes.

The remaining seven original controls were deliberately not run after benefit rejection; all eight remain mandatory before any adoption. No pooling, cost subtraction, resampling, threshold change, renderer rerun or frame claim. All72 canonical protected products stayed exact. Independent completion audit accepted the rejection and ownership record.

[Complete source/compiler/producer/runtime/rejection evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/f851c664135b2fdd579cc8daab4eecf6036c84ef/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/packed-retained-scratch-rejected/manifest.json) is committed and pushed under evidence/packed-scratch-and-july-snapshots-5b2df58b (f851c664). Source remains clean pushed 5b2df58b on its development branch. The current native frame timeout, original cold software frame, usable UI/high-resolution scenes, full scientific/Mandatory and release obligations remain open.
